introduction.value: Early Operator users had it scan job listings against a resume, compile details on 50 financial YouTubers with LinkedIn and emails, and test local dev environments; some sites blocked it.

method.value: Early Operator users tried it on real tasks. Dan Mac uploaded a resume and had it scan job listings for a match. outcome.value: The job search found a matching role, though slowly. The YouTuber task failed: after 20 minutes the user quit with an incomplete table holding wrong contact details for 18 people. Some sites, such as eBay, blocked it.

notes.value: The YouTuber run searched Bing instead of YouTube and couldn't find a suitable spreadsheet, so give it explicit tools and sources, and expect to supervise it.

source_text.body:
Scan job listings and compile contact lists with Operator
Early Operator users had it scan job listings against a resume, compile details on 50 financial YouTubers with LinkedIn and emails, and test local dev environments; some sites blocked it.
Done with
OP
Operator
What they did
Early Operator users tried it on real tasks. Dan Mac uploaded a resume and had it scan job listings for a match. A Reddit user asked it to build a table of 50 financial YouTubers with LinkedIn profiles and emails. Kieran Klaassen tested it on local development environments. Chris Koerner needed some initial hand-holding before it ran on its own.
How it went
The job search found a matching role, though slowly. The YouTuber task failed: after 20 minutes the user quit with an incomplete table holding wrong contact details for 18 people. Some sites, such as eBay, blocked it.
Worth knowing
The YouTuber run searched Bing instead of YouTube and couldn't find a suitable spreadsheet, so give it explicit tools and sources, and expect to supervise it.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Search [job sites] for [job title] roles in [location] and compare each listing against my resume at [resume location or pasted text]. Build a table of the 15 best matches with company, role, link, and why it fits. Stop when the table is done. Do not submit any applications or forms, and tell me if a site blocks you.
Original source: https://the-decoder.com/some-examples-of-how-early-users-are-trying-to-use-chatgpts-operator/
